bio_am: Քրիստափոր Միքայէլեանի քրոջ որդին, 1898-1918 Սալմաստի յեղափոխական գործունէութեան ղեկավարը։ Մահացած է Թաւրիզ՝ 1 Մարտ 1945-ին։
bio_en: Stepan Tadevosian, known as Samson Khan of Salmast, was the son of ARF founder Kristapor Mikaelian's sister and was trained at the Tiflis craft school as a gunsmith before working in the ARF's 'Kharisk' arms workshop in Tabriz. In 1898 the party sent him to Salmast, and from 1898 to 1918 the ARF's work in Salmast was above all his: he organised the armed bands, guides and supply routes that crossed into the Ottoman provinces. In 1904 he attended the 3rd General Congress in Geneva. In 1918 he led the self-defence of Salmast and the fighting against the invading Turkish army with Kostia Hambardzumian and Levon Shaghoyan, and he died in Tabriz on 1 March 1945.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Quotes #17 and #64 are attributed to 'Samson'. Brother of Hovsep Tadevosian and of Papasha (Levon Tadevosian).
